name: team-coordination
description: Start or reuse an Astra project-analysis chat that forms tailored leader and teammate chats in the Codex sidebar; coordinate roles, ownership, evidence and recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Astra project analysis and tailored sidebar teams
interface.longDescription: Start or reuse a user-requested Astra project-analysis chat that forms a tailored separate leader and distinctive professional teammate chats through official Codex app tools. Managed adapter operations are separate; runtime source is in tools/codex-team-harness. Installation creates no chats and does not modify global guidance, runtime, hooks, models or authentication.
defaultPrompt: Use $team-coordination to start an Astra project-analysis chat that creates separate leader and tailored teammate chats in the Codex sidebar, or reuse this task's existing team.
